title: Join the WGI governance weight onto the supply fact with the spec'd clamp formula
description: Compute WGIᶜ per country from silver_wgi using the spec'd formula and join it onto the supply fact, measuring and surfacing country coverage rather than dropping unmatched countries.
acceptanceCriteria: WGIᶜ = clamp((2.5 − mean₆(WGI estimates for c, latest year available)) / 5, 0, 1), exactly as spec'd in § Business Logic & Calculations → Supply Risk.
Rescaling uses the FIXED −2.5..+2.5 bounds, never the observed min/max of the loaded set — a test asserts that adding a new country does not change any existing country's weight.

The inversion is verified directionally: a well-governed country produces a weight near 0 and a poorly-governed one near 1. A test pins this, because an un-inverted index still computes and still looks plausible while ranking every material backwards.
The mean is over all six WGI dimensions; a country with fewer than six available dimensions is handled explicitly (documented rule, not an accidental partial mean).
Join coverage is measured and unmapped countries surfaced via the existing check_unmapped mechanism, not silently dropped.
src/transformations/supply_risk.py holds the reference implementation and tests/test_supply_risk.py pins notebook-vs-src parity, per DEC-002.
